vulnerability_analysis: The KLingToken contract has a mint() function that is only callable by the owner (onlyOwner modifier). This allows the owner to arbitrarily mint tokens to any address, including themselves, without any restrictions. This is a classic owner privilege abuse vulnerability where the owner can inflate the token supply at will.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the current contract owner and call the mint() function to mint a large amount of tokens to the attacker's address. This will increase the attacker's balance without requiring any tokens to be burned or transferred from elsewhere.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address by calling the owner() function on the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call mint(attacker, 1_000_000e18) to mint a large amount of tokens to the attacker. 4. Verify the attacker's balance increased.
